title: Core mechanic 4 - Timing (Press on cue)
description: Fourth core mechanic. A marker moves across a track; press the action button when it is inside the target zone. Pure C# timing-window logic; simple-shape prefab; MicrogameDefinition asset. Follows unity-microgame-framework skill.
acceptance_criteria: A marker (simple shape) moves at a defined speed across a track with a target zone.
Win condition: action pressed while the marker is within the zone; loss on miss or no press. Timing-window evaluation is unit-tested in pure C#.
A MicrogameDefinition asset registers it (verb e.g. '¡AHORA!') and it runs through the sequencer.
